text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Director Akikawa asks Trainer Kiryuin and me to take part in a promotional event for the URA Finale.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Things don't quite go to plan, and we end up performing a mini-concert on stage together in place of our trainees…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …but in any case, we succeed in spreading the word about the event.
